messages.speaker: Priya
messages.text: Hi, my package still has not turned up and it was meant to arrive on Friday.

messages.speaker: Support
messages.text: Sorry about that. Can you give me the order number so I can look it up?

messages.speaker: Priya
messages.text: It is order 48120.

messages.speaker: Support
messages.text: Thanks. I can see it left the warehouse on Wednesday but it is sitting at the sorting hub in Leeds.

messages.speaker: Priya
messages.text: So how long until it actually gets to me?

messages.speaker: Support
messages.text: Deliveries stuck at that hub usually clear within two working days, so Wednesday at the latest.

messages.speaker: Priya
messages.text: That is annoying, I paid extra for next day shipping.

messages.speaker: Support
messages.text: That is fair. I have refunded the shipping fee of 6.99 back to your card. It takes three to five days to show up on your statement.

messages.speaker: Priya
messages.text: Thank you. While I have you, I cannot get into my account either.

messages.speaker: Support
messages.text: What happens when you try to sign in?

messages.speaker: Priya
messages.text: It just says the credentials do not match, but I am sure the password is right.

messages.speaker: Support
messages.text: Your account was locked after five failed attempts, which is a security measure. I have unlocked it now.

messages.speaker: Priya
messages.text: Do I need to pick a new password?

messages.speaker: Support
messages.text: Not necessarily, but I would recommend it. Use the reset link on the sign in page and it will email you a fresh one.

messages.speaker: Priya
messages.text: Got the email, that worked. One more thing, the jacket I ordered is the wrong size.

messages.speaker: Support
messages.text: No problem. You have 30 days from delivery to send anything back for a full refund or an exchange.

messages.speaker: Priya
messages.text: Does it cost me anything to return it?

messages.speaker: Support
messages.text: Returns are free within the UK. We email you a prepaid label and you drop it at any post office.

messages.speaker: Priya
messages.text: And when would I get the money back?

messages.speaker: Support
messages.text: We process the refund within two days of the parcel reaching our warehouse, then your bank takes another three to five days.

messages.speaker: Priya
messages.text: Perfect. Can I swap it for the same jacket in a large instead of getting money back?

messages.speaker: Support
messages.text: Yes. Choose exchange rather than refund on the returns form and we ship the replacement as soon as we scan the original in.

messages.speaker: Priya
messages.text: Is the large actually in stock right now?

messages.speaker: Support
messages.text: We have four left in that colour. I have put one aside under your account for the next fourteen days.

messages.speaker: Priya
messages.text: Brilliant, thank you for sorting all of that.

messages.speaker: Support
messages.text: Happy to help. You will get three emails: the shipping refund, the returns label, and the exchange confirmation.

messages.speaker: Priya
messages.text: One last question, do you deliver to work addresses?

messages.speaker: Support
messages.text: We do, and business addresses are usually faster because someone is always there to sign for the parcel.

messages.speaker: Priya
messages.text: Then send the replacement to my office. I will update the address on the form.

messages.speaker: Support
messages.text: Noted on the order. Anything else I can pick up for you today?

messages.speaker: Priya
messages.text: No, that is everything. Thanks again.
